fields.label: Your story
fields.sample:
It all started on an ordinary Tuesday evening, in a small bookstore in Kadıköy. Two hands reaching for the same book at the same moment, a shy smile and the words “You take it, I’ll wait”… One of us kept the book, the other the phone number.
Then came long walks, conversations that lasted till morning, cities we got lost in together. We became each other’s best friend; in laughter and in hard times, we were always on the same side.
One summer evening, a single question asked outside the bookstore where we first met changed everything. The answer was short: “Yes.” Now we want to write the most beautiful page of this story together with you.

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.sample:
Thank you endlessly for being with us on this journey, for sharing our joy and for making this day unforgettable for us.
We’re so glad to have you; here’s to meeting again on many more happy days.

elements.text:
The independent
wedding paper. Founded:
today.

elements.name: Kapak spotu
elements.text: Two people, one decision. A seven-year story turns a new page at the altar; details inside. Our only request: that you be with us that day.

elements.name: Altyazı
elements.text: Fig. 1 — The decision. Photo: Go Post

elements.name: Başlık
elements.text: Two people, one decision: a seven-year story at the altar

elements.name: Haber metni
elements.text:
The story that began seven years ago in a small book­store in Kadıköy is moving into a new chap­ter. The couple an­nounced their de­ci­sion to marry to their inner circle in a single word: “Yes.” The state­ment went into no detail; the de­tails are on the inside pages of this newspaper.
Behind the de­ci­sion lie long walks, a book­case built to­geth­er and a shared morn­ing rou­tine. A source close to the couple said their big­gest dis­agree­ment had been whether to take their coffee with sugar or with­out, and that a com­pro­mise on the matter was reached before the wedding.
The cer­e­mo­ny will follow a simple pro­gram: wel­come, cer­e­mo­ny, dinner and danc­ing. The only ex­pec­ta­tion of guests is that they be there on the day. No dress code has been set; com­fort­able shoes, how­ev­er, are es­pe­cial­ly rec­om­mend­ed. Pro­gram, venue and travel in­for­ma­tion is on page 3; the couple’s story and in­ter­view are on page 2.
Preparations are in the final stretch. This news­pa­per has taken the place of in­vi­ta­tions; guests need only show it at the en­trance. The couple is also clear about wed­ding gifts: the best gift is a few hours spent on the dance floor that evening.

elements.name: Alıntı
elements.text: “A compromise was reached on coffee, too: one with sugar, one without.”

elements.name: Alıntı sahibi
elements.text: — A source close to the couple

elements.name: Kısa haber
elements.text: The cer­e­mo­ny has been timed to co­in­cide with sunset. Guests are asked to arrive half an hour early.

elements.name: Kısa haber
elements.text: No rules; only com­fort­able shoes are rec­om­mend­ed. The dance floor stays open past mid­night.

elements.name: Kısa haber
elements.text: For the seat­ing plan, just let us know at least two weeks ahead. A mes­sage will do.

elements.text: Book to one, number to the other.

elements.name: Rakam notu ay sonra evet
elements.text: Each one a story of its own.

elements.text: A story that began in a Kadıköy bookstore, lasted seven years and was crowned with a single word.

elements.text: Two hands, one book, seven years

elements.name: Kronoloji metni
elements.text: An Aegean road trip with one map. Map lost, way found.

elements.name: Kronoloji metni
elements.text: Two bookcases merged; the shelves ran out, so another wall went to books.

elements.name: Kronoloji metni
elements.text: Same bookstore, one question, one answer. The planned speech was cut short.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: In a small book­store in Kadıköy, we reached for the same book at the same time. One of us kept the book, the other the phone number. The next week we met on the pre­text of re­turn­ing the book; the rest came with long walks.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: One said “very polite,” the other “a little shy.” Both were right. Over the years we’ve both become a bit braver and a bit more pa­tient; the shy­ness only comes back when we’re being pho­tographed.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: One summer evening, out­side the book­store where we met. The speech re­hearsed for weeks stopped at the first line; the answer came before the ques­tion. The book­sell­er ap­plaud­ed from inside.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: Books, long walks and Sunday break­fast. And a never-ending cross­word: we don’t leave the table until it’s solved. The busiest corner of the house is the book­case; the coffee ma­chine comes second.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: Sugar in the coffee. After lengthy ne­go­ti­a­tions, a com­pro­mise text was draft­ed: one takes it with sugar, the other with­out, and the cups will never be mixed up. The text hangs on the fridge door.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: Having our loved ones to­geth­er; the rest is detail. And a dance floor that stays full till morn­ing. We made the playlist to­geth­er; full agree­ment was reached on all but two songs.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: Wear com­fort­able shoes and keep phones pock­et­ed during the cer­e­mo­ny; af­ter­ward, take as many photos as you like. Thanks in ad­vance to all who prom­ise short speech­es.

elements.name: Cevap
elements.text: It’s like read­ing the same book a second time: each time you un­der­line a dif­fer­ent line and re­al­ize what you missed the first time around.

elements.name: Altyazı 2
elements.text: Fig. 3 — A summer evening: question, answer.

elements.name: Alıntı
elements.text: “One of us kept the book, the other the phone number.”

elements.name: Not
elements.text: The book still sits by the couple’s bed. Its last page is saved to read to­geth­er the first Sunday after the wed­ding.

elements.name: Bölüm notu
elements.text: From welcome to last song, the big day hour by hour.

elements.text: Stand at the door all night

elements.name: Altyazı 3
elements.text: Fig. 4 — Rehearsal dinner, a week before.

elements.name: Bilgi metni
elements.text: Relaxed elegance. Any color goes; just make sure your shoes can dance. Lawn in the garden: skip the stilettos.

elements.name: Bilgi metni
elements.text: A message or call at least two weeks ahead is all it takes. The seating plan will follow from it.

elements.name: Bilgi metni
elements.text: A June evening: 21 degrees and clear. A light jacket or shawl will do for the night.

elements.name: Bilgi metni
elements.text: There’s a play corner in the garden; little guests are VIPs. A sitter will be there all evening.

elements.name: Kupon notu
elements.text: Just show this newspaper at the entrance.

elements.name: Kırmızı blok yazısı
elements.text: Our one request: be with us that day.

elements.name: Bölüm notu
elements.text: Final word, guests’ wishes and this issue’s masthead.

elements.name: Sıradaki metin
elements.text: Sea first, then the city. Postcards on the way.

elements.name: Sıradaki metin
elements.text: The bookcase is doubling in size; shelving help welcome.

elements.name: Sıradaki metin
elements.text: Same bookstore, same time. This time, the book is ours.

elements.name: Altyazı 4
elements.text: Fig. 5 — The first day of a lifetime. Photo: family album

elements.name: Dilek
elements.text: “We’ve known since that day at the bookstore. A lifetime of joy.”

elements.name: Dilek
elements.text: “Two bookcases merged; now it’s the families’ turn.”

elements.name: Dilek
elements.text: “See you on the dance floor. Shoes already on standby.”

elements.name: Dilek
elements.text: “I’ll keep my speech short. I promise.”

elements.name: Dilek
elements.text: “With sugar or without, who cares? As long as it’s one table.”

elements.name: Dilek
elements.text: “I’m framing this paper for my wall.”

elements.name: Dilek
elements.text: “Fair warning: I’ll be asking for the cake recipe.”

elements.name: Dilek
elements.text: “Just so you know, we’ll be first on the dance floor.”

elements.name: Kapanış notu
elements.text: This issue was printed as a single copy, exclusively for the guests of this wedding. Keep it in your archive and read it again years from now.

elements.name: Alt bilgi
elements.text: Go Post — Personalized edition. Not for sale; handed out with love.
